summary: 可访问的流式终端输出容器
expected: 提供可组合的长输出容器、跟随底部/手动滚动策略、更新通知的 aria-live 区域与输出密度；基于 UiScrollbar 和标准 DOM，不保存命令历史、不调度异步任务。
acceptanceCriteria: 仅当视图已位于底部时自动跟随新增输出；向上查看历史时不会抢滚，内容可选中复制。
长列表、流式状态更新和重置时不引发滚动抖动或无限尺寸扩张，移动端和 reduced-motion 均能正常使用。
若 UiScrollbar + 消费端逻辑即可满足，应给出复用方案而不是新增冗余组件。

consumers.scenario: 首页将显示启动日志、命令历史和后端返回的流式终端输出

resolution: Accepted 2026-10-13. UiTerminalTranscript native scroll/log and tail-following are consumed in real XCA TerminalHost.vue. Fixed native layout scroll incorrectly disabling following before ResizeObserver; minimal XCA terminal-resize.spec.ts failed at 72px before the fix and passes after synced production build, retaining draft and preserving history readers. UI terminal-resize/terminal-composition and full acceptance suite 24/24; Vue 70/70; XCA full E2E 71/71 including scroll/clear/intro/resize/reduced-motion. Shared release snapshots and 5 real XCA snapshots reviewed by luna/max. See docs/acceptance-2026-10-13.md and .changeset/terminal-resize-following.md. No publication.
